title: Recalculate sharing rules for an object
when: The step asks to recalculate sharing rules for one named object (Account, Lead, Case, a custom object, ...) from the Sharing Settings page, typically after changing role hierarchy, groups or ownership in bulk. It is not creating or editing a sharing rule, and it is not changing organization-wide defaults.
steps: In the embedded Sharing Settings page, find the Sharing Rules section for the object the step names, for example 'Account Sharing Rules'.
Click the 'Recalculate' button in that section only. Every object has its own Recalculate button.
If a confirmation appears, confirm it.
doneWhen: The named object's 'Recalculate' button was clicked and the page responded. Recalculation of a large object runs for hours; Salesforce emails when it ends.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; one click on the Lead row's Recalculate (p=1.00 among a dozen identical buttons), 9 s, and the run ended there without waiting. Confirmed without any model: the Setup Audit Trail recorded 'Initiated sharing rule recalculation: Lead'. The first attempt failed with max_tokens_exceeded from Jev: this page lists rules and buttons for every object. Oversized requests are now retried with the controls most relevant to the goal.

trial.step: Recalculate the sharing rules for Lead.

notes: Recalculation of a large object can run for hours. The recipe only starts it.
